title: Google is mandating Android app support for foldables starting in April 2027, saying developers must meet Tier 3 standards by filling display areas and more (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Google is mandating Android app support for foldables starting in April 2027, saying developers must meet Tier 3 standards by filling display areas and more — Now that the iPhone Duo is foldable is here, Google wants to make sure apps on Android foldables
reason: Google mandating Android app support standards for foldables is a platform/developer requirement, not a model release (R1), research artifact (R2), business event like financing/M&A/partnership/product launch (R3), government policy action (R4), or open-source tooling release (R5). No rule covers it
